listing.name: Ultima IV: Quest of the Avatar (Master System) — u4-sms-recompiled (alexdia25)
listing.original_game_title: Ultima IV: Quest of the Avatar (Master System)
listing.summary: The project describes native map, combat, shop, dungeon, audio and save systems with reference comparisons. Full-game completion has not been independently verified. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own European/USA 512 KiB ROM with SHA1 a90e21e5961bcf2e10b715a009c04e7c2017a3b1.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: For a source build, run setup.py ROM --pc to create the asset pack, translated C and native u4.exe using Zig and SDL2. Player packages can import your ROM once and then run from u4.pak without it. The recorded review did not inspect published asset bytes.

warnings: The project describes native map, combat, shop, dungeon, audio and save systems with reference comparisons. Full-game completion has not been independently verified.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
